title:
Make knowledge
playable.
points: Use it in a new case
narration: Meet Neural Draft. Apply a skill in a short simulation, forge a personal card, and put what you learned into play.

title:
An update that
cannot wait?
narration: The Solo Forge starts with a suspicious vendor update. Production is healthy, but an unfamiliar sender demands an urgent installation.

title:
Read the signals.
Ask a question.
narration: Nova inspects the evidence and asks Leena how to verify the update. The signer is unexpected. Leena points to a trusted contact, independent of the email.

title:
Pause. Verify.
Preserve.
narration: Nova pauses the rollout, preserves evidence, and chooses independent verification. A one sentence reason records the judgement behind that action.

title:
A decision becomes
a signature.
narration: The decision becomes Nova's Relay Architect. Its Coordinate effect spreads influence between fronts, reflecting the choice to connect evidence, operations, and a trusted contact.

title:
Show exactly
why it was earned.
narration: This offline demo scores the selected action and inspected evidence. It saves, but does not interpret, the written reason. Higher scores change appearance, never unrestricted power.

title:
Keep the card.
Keep the evidence.
narration: The card and evidence stay in the local collection. Select a forged card and bring it, plus five starters, into a duel.

title:
One room code.
A worthy rival.
narration: A second player joins with the room code. Quick demo provides an explicitly labelled practice card, so judges can reach the duel immediately.

title:
A new case.
The same skill.
narration: The new case concerns an unusual file export. Across four rounds, both players compete for influence on Evidence, Response, and People.

title:
Choose. Place.
Lock in.
narration: Each player secretly chooses an unused card and a front. Nova locks the forged card. The rival sees only that the move is sealed.

title:
The clue must
fit the decision.
narration: Investigate requires choosing a relevant clue. Orion connects the export audit to the Evidence front. Applying the skill again unlocks the fixed bonus.

title:
Both plays.
One resolution.
narration: Both plays reveal together. The server awards the clue bonus and spreads Nova's coordination influence. Every score change has an explicit explanation.

title:
Match the evidence
to the response.
narration: In round two, Nova uses the live session clue to support Response. Orion contests that same front with Contain. Both earn their conditional bonuses.

title:
Timing changes
the outcome.
narration: In round three, Nova's containment predicts the contested People front. Orion's Challenge finds no eligible counter. Tactical choices matter, with only four fixed effects.

title:
Win the fronts.
Keep the insight.
narration: After round four, Nova leads two of the three fronts and wins. The result shows influential moves and a short learning insight based on the actual plays.

title:
Learn. Forge.
Play. Repeat.
points: Cards reset for a fresh duel
narration: Both players can accept a rematch, while their collections remain saved. Neural Draft turns a learning decision into a skill you can use again.
